title: DCP d-ary Qudit Phase-Register Modular SUM Carry and Step-Function Linearity Bridge
claims: For any v in ker(A mod d), the d-ary modular SUM phase increment Phi(u; y) - Phi(0; y) lies in (d Z_{d^t})^n across 100% of syndromes y in Z_d^K.
For d >= 3 and t >= 2, the threshold carry 1[y_r + u >= d] is a non-linear step function of u in Z_d for y_r != 0, so all-syndrome linearity mod d^t holds iff A_{.,r} == 0 (mod d^{t-1}) on supp(v).
